scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:all: npm run build:data && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:cms: concurrently -n cms-api,cms -c magenta,cyan "npm run cms -w server" "npm run dev -w cms"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,client,cms-api,cms -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run cms -w server" "npm run dev -w cms"
